name: [JUGGERNAUT] Super Toilet Brawl
desc:
(It is recommended to play in Private Servers)

Mini Update:
-New secret badge (play Onslaught Mode)
-New Forge character (Elite Juggernaut Astro Toilet)
-Elite Juggernaut Astro Toilet boss in Onslaught Mode
-New VIP exclusive character (Bling Camerahead)

HOW TO PLAY: 
-Defeat waves of toilets to gain more kills 
-Once you have enough, you can unlock more weapons and characters
-Each wave gets harder and harder
-If all players die at least once during a wave, the game resets back to wave 1

USING EXPLOITS WILL RESULT IN A PERMANENT BAN FROM THE GAME!
